data.title: NU E Power Converts Related-Party Debt Into Equity Units
data.description:

data.title: Findev to Write Off Victoria Park Loan Amid CCAA Realization
data.description:

Findev Inc. says it will write off the remaining carrying value of its loan exposure to 1682 Victoria Park Avenue Inc. following court-supervised restructuring proceedings. data.title: DLP Resources Launches Maiden Drill Program at Peru’s Esperanza Copper Project
data.description:
The latest update is out from DLP Resources ( (TSE:DLP) ).

DLP Resources has begun its first-ever diamond drill program at the 100%-owned Esperanza copper-gold-molybdenum project in southern Peru, marking the initial drilling on a sizeable, previously untested land package. The campaign, launched after permitting and rapid mobilization supported by strong local infrastructure, is designed to evaluate both shallow copper oxide mineralisation and a large porphyry system at depth.

The approximately 3,000-metre program will test a 300 m by 700 m near-surface copper oxide zone with four shallow holes, followed by three 800-metre holes into the main porphyry target beneath a 5.0 km by 2.5 km magnetic anomaly. Initial assay results are expected from the shallow holes, with deeper results to follow, and successful outcomes could materially advance DLP’s exploration pipeline and strengthen its position in Peru’s copper-focused mining corridor.
